newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Two hurt as gunman opens fire in Swiss church - police.
newsitem.headline: Two hurt as gunman opens fire in Swiss church - police.

text.p: A gunman entered a church in the centre of Geneva on Saturday and opened fire on worshippers, wounding two people, police said.
The unidentified gunman entered Notre Dame Roman Catholic Church and attacked a small group of worshippers there at around 1830 GMT, police spokesman Alexander Baerisswyl said.
The gunman was still holed up in the church two hours after the attack, Baerisswyl told reporters.

"He's still inside. We are trying to talk to him. We sent psychologists but there has been no dialogue so far," Baerisswyl said. "If dialogue does not work we'll have to use force. The person entered the church and wounded two of the worshippers," he said.
Police cordoned off roads in the centre of the town as hundreds of people gathered to watch.
